items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: It was a group that was there. It was Tommy Miller.

ctx.x: The same group? You brought a group with you?

No, no. It was a group that was there. It was Tommy Miller. It was an organ player and singer, very talented, he sings like Ray Charles, Nat King Cole, Billy Eckstine and he played organ, you know. And we had drums and myself, you know. We were entertainment because of my show business which I had learned and with his entertainment we were able to work, you know what I mean. We made money for everybody we worked for, you know.
